## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.
It returns code, a screenshot, and contextual hints.

Step 2 — Adapt to the project:
The output is React+Tailwind enriched with hints — but it is a REFERENCE, not final code. Always adapt to the target project's stack, components, and conventions.
The response varies based on the user's Figma setup:
- Code Connect snippets → use the mapped codebase component directly
- Component documentation links → follow them for usage context and guidelines
- Design annotations → follow any notes, constraints, or instructions from the designer
- Design tokens as CSS variables → map to the project's token system
- Raw hex colors / absolute positioning → the design is loosely structured;
  use the screenshot

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".

- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring or one-time remote agent ("run this every Monday", "open a cleanup PR for X in 2 weeks"), or to manage existing routines. ALSO OFFER PROACTIVELY: after you finish work that has a natural future follow-up, end your reply with a one-line offer to schedule a background agent to do it. Strong signals: a feature flag / gate / experiment / staged rollout was just shipped (offer a one-time agent in ~2 weeks to open a cleanup PR or evaluate results), a new alert/monitor was created (offer a recurring agent to triage it), a TODO/migration with a "remove once X" condition was left behind (offer a one-time agent to do the removal). Skip the offer for refactors, bug fixes, and anything that is done once it ships. ## Flash Events Page Exploration Report

### 1. MAIN PAGE FILE

**Purpose:** Server-side page listing all flash events for a studio owner. Handles auth, filtering, and suspense-based rendering.

```tsx
/>
```

- `page.tsx` — List view (main page)
- `loading.tsx` — Fallback loader

**Purpose:** Server-side detail page. Loads event, slots, and style tags in parallel. Delegates UI to `FlashEventDetailShell`.

## InkOS Next.js 16 App — Reusable Patterns Report

**Medium breadth exploration complete.** Here are the key reusable patterns for the Flash Events page rebuild:

---

### 1. PageShell, PageHeader, PageTabs — Full API

**PageShell** (`components/shared/PageShell.tsx:1-80`)
- Props: `fullHeight?: boolean`, `maxWidth?: number | false`, `className?: string`, `innerClassName?: string`
- Default max-width: 1440px
- Renders branded page container with radial gradient highlights (top-right) + rust whisper (bottom-left)
- Base padding: `px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pt-6 pb-10`, vertical rhythm via `gap-6`

**PageHeader** (`components/shared/PageHeader.tsx:1-112`)
- Props: `title: string`, `description?: string`, `actions?: React.ReactNode`, `breadcrumb?: BreadcrumbItemDef[]`, `backHref?: string`
- Renders Instrument Serif H1 with underline rust divider
- Optional back link, breadcrumb trail, and action buttons (right-aligned)
- Breadcrumb items: `{ label: string, href?: string }` (missing href = current page)

**PageTabs** (`components/shared/PageTabs.tsx:1-145`)
- Props: `tabs: PageTab[]`, `activeKey: string`, `currentPlan: PlanTier`, `currentRole: NavRole`
- Tab structure: `{ key, label, href, badge?: number | string, badgeTone?: 'default' | 'danger', gated?: PlanTier, hidden?: (role) => boolean }`
- Features: URL persistence via `?tab=` query param, arrow-key navigation, plan-gating with lock visual, role-based hiding
- Badges support red "danger" tone for overdue counts

---

### 2. UI Primitives in components/ui/ — Main Props

**Button** — `variant: 'default' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'destructive' | 'link'`, `size: 'default' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon' | 'icon-xs' | 'icon-sm' | 'icon-lg'`, `nativeButton`, `loading`, `disabled`

**Card** — `size?: 'default' | 'sm'`, standard div props; sub-slots: `CardHeader`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`, `CardDescription`, `CardTitle`

**Tabs** — `value`, `onValueChange`, `defaultValue`; sub-slots: `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`

**Table** — Container wrapper with overflow-x-auto; sub: `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`

**DropdownMenu** — `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent` (props: `align`, `side`, `sideOffset`), `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`

**AlertDialog** — `AlertDialogTrigger`, `AlertDialogContent`, `AlertDialogHeader`, `AlertDialogTitle`, `AlertDialogDescription`, `AlertDialogFooter`, `AlertDialogAction`, `AlertDialogCancel`

**Dialog** — Base-UI backed; `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogClose`

**Sheet** (Drawer) — `Sheet`, `SheetTrigger`, `SheetContent` (props: `side: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'`, `showCloseButton`), `SheetOverlay`, `SheetClose`

**Select** — `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`, `SelectContent`, `SelectItem`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectLabel`, `SelectSeparator`

**Input** — `type`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, standard HTML input props

**Form** — React Hook Form adapter; `Form`, `FormField`, `FormItem`, `FormLabel`, `FormControl`, `FormMessage`, `FormDescription`

**Tooltip** — `TooltipProvider`, `Tooltip`, `TooltipTrigger`, `TooltipContent`

**Badge** — `variant?: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline'`

**Progress** — `value: number`, `max?: number`, `className`

**Skeleton** — `className?: string`; renders animated placeholder

**Toast** (sonner) — `toast('message')`, `toast.success()`, `toast.error()`, `toast.loading()`, `toast.promise()`

### 3. FeatureGate Component

**No standalone FeatureGate component found.** Feature gating is implemented via:

### 7. Server-side Supabase Client

`lib/supabase/server.ts:23-47` — `createClient()` (with `await cookies()`):

### 8. Existing List Pages — Structure Pattern

**app/(app)/clients/page.tsx** (server):
- Wraps with `<Page>` high-level composite (line 57)
- Fetches initial data in parallel (Promise.all)
- Passes to client component via props with Suspense fallback

**app/(app)/payments/page.tsx** (tabbed example):

**Filter/toolbar pattern** (`PageToolbar` at `components/shared/PageToolbar.tsx`):
- Slots: `search`, `filters`, `meta` (record count), `tools` (icons)
- Two-row layout: primary row + optional children (active filters, bulk-action banner)

**ItemForm** (`components/inventory/ItemForm.tsx:1-80`):

**Sheet component** (`components/ui/sheet.tsx`):

- `showCloseButton` prop, `<SheetClose>` for manual close

### 10. Currency Formatting

`lib/utils.ts:14-21`:

```typescript
export function formatCurrency(cents: number, currency = 'USD', locale = 'en-US'): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    style: 'currency',

    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,

}
```

**package.json**: `"qrcode": "^1.5.4"` + `"@types/qrcode": "^1.5.6"`

---

### 12. Money/Cents Handling Pattern

All monetary amounts stored as **cents** (integers):
- `cost_per_unit_cents`, `retail_price_cents` (inventory form, line 37-38)
- `amount_cents` in deposit/payment flows

### 1. PageShell, PageHeader, PageTabs — Full API

**PageShell** (`components/shared/PageShell.tsx:1-80`)
- Props: `fullHeight?: boolean`, `maxWidth?: number | false`, `className?: string`, `innerClassName?: string`
- Default max-width: 1440px
- Renders branded page container with radial gradient highlights (top-right) + rust whisper (bottom-left)
- Base padding: `px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pt-6 pb-10`, vertical rhythm via `gap-6`

**PageHeader** (`components/shared/PageHeader.tsx:1-112`)
- Props: `title: string`, `description?: string`, `actions?: React.ReactNode`, `breadcrumb?: BreadcrumbItemDef[]`, `backHref?: string`
- Renders Instrument Serif H1 with underline rust divider
- Optional back link, breadcrumb trail, and action buttons (right-aligned)
- Breadcrumb items: `{ label: string, href?: string }` (missing href = current page)

**PageTabs** (`components/shared/PageTabs.tsx:1-145`)
- Props: `tabs: PageTab[]`, `activeKey: string`, `currentPlan: PlanTier`, `currentRole: NavRole`
- Tab structure: `{ key, label, href, badge?: number | string, badgeTone?: 'default' | 'danger', gated?: PlanTier, hidden?: (role) => boolean }`
- Features: URL persistence via `?tab=` query param, arrow-key navigation, plan-gating with lock visual, role-based hiding
- Badges support red "danger" tone for overdue counts

---

### 2. UI Primitives in components/ui/ — Main Props

**Button** — `variant: 'default' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'destructive' | 'link'`, `size: 'default' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon' | 'icon-xs' | 'icon-sm' | 'icon-lg'`, `nativeButton`, `loading`, `disabled`

**Card** — `size?: 'default' | 'sm'`, standard div props; sub-slots: `CardHeader`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`, `CardDescription`, `CardTitle`

**Tabs** — `value`, `onValueChange`, `defaultValue`; sub-slots: `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`

**Table** — Container wrapper with overflow-x-auto; sub: `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`

**DropdownMenu** — `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent` (props: `align`, `side`, `sideOffset`), `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`

**AlertDialog** — `AlertDialogTrigger`, `AlertDialogContent`, `AlertDialogHeader`, `AlertDialogTitle`, `AlertDialogDescription`, `AlertDialogFooter`, `AlertDialogAction`, `AlertDialogCancel`

**Dialog** — Base-UI backed; `DialogTrigger`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogClose`

**Sheet** (Drawer) — `Sheet`, `SheetTrigger`, `SheetContent` (props: `side: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'`, `showCloseButton`), `SheetOverlay`, `SheetClose`

**Select** — `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`, `SelectContent`, `SelectItem`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectLabel`, `SelectSeparator`

**Input** — `type`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, standard HTML input props

**Form** — React Hook Form adapter; `Form`, `FormField`, `FormItem`, `FormLabel`, `FormControl`, `FormMessage`, `FormDescription`

**Tooltip** — `TooltipProvider`, `Tooltip`, `TooltipTrigger`, `TooltipContent`

**Badge** — `variant?: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline'`

**Progress** — `value: number`, `max?: number`, `className`

**Skeleton** — `className?: string`; renders animated placeholder

**No standalone FeatureGate component found.** Feature gating is implemented via:
- `hasFeature(plan: PlanTier, feature: string): boolean` — static check in `lib/billing/feature-gate.ts:119-123`

- `requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, featureKey): Promise<void>` — throws `FeatureGateError` if locked (dev mode: pass-through)
- Used directly in Server Components & API routes; no client wrapper exists.

### 6. Audit Logger — logAuditAction Signature

`lib/audit.ts:11-36`:

Writes to `audit_log` table via service-role client (bypasses RLS). Failures logged but never throw.

`lib/supabase/server.ts:23-47` — `createClient()` (with `await cookies()`):

- Wrapped in `React.cache()` for deduplication

- Bypasses RLS for admin/webhook operations

**app/(app)/clients/page.tsx** (server):

```typescript
export function formatCurrency(cents: number, currency = 'USD', locale = 'en-US'): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {

    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
```

57	export async function listFlashEvents(
58	  studioId: string,
59	  filters: FlashEventFilter = {}
60	): Promise<FlashEventListItem[]> {
61	  const supabase = await createClient()
62	
63	  let query = supabase
64	    .from('flash_events')
65	    .select(`
66	      *,
67	      artist:artists(id, display_name, avatar_url),
68	      location:locations(id, name)
69	    `)
70	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
71	    .order('event_date', { ascending: false })
72	
73	  if (filters.status && filters.status !== 'all') {
74	    if (filters.status === 'upcoming') {
75	      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
76	      query = query.gte('event_date', today)
77	    } else {
78	      query = query.eq('status', filters.status)
79	    }
80	  }
81	
82	  const { data, error } = await query
83	
84	  if (error) {
85	    logger.error({ error, studioId }, 'listFlashEvents failed')
86	    throw new Error('Failed to load flash events')
87	  }
88	
89	  if (!data) return []
90	
91	  // Fetch slot summaries in bulk
92	  const eventIds = data.map((e) => e.id)
93	  const { data: slots } = await supabase
94	    .from('flash_event_slots')
95	    .select('flash_event_id, status')
96	    .in('flash_event_id', eventIds)
97	
98	  const summaryMap = new Map<string, { total: number; booked: number; available: number }>()
99	  for (const slot of slots ?? []) {
100	    const existing = summaryMap.get(slot.flash_event_id) ?? { total: 0, booked: 0, available: 0 }
101	    existing.total += 1
102	    if (slot.status === 'booked') existing.booked += 1
103	    if (slot.status === 'open') existing.available += 1
104	    summaryMap.set(slot.flash_event_id, existing)
105	  }
106	
107	  return data.map((event) => ({
108	    ...event,
109	    artist: (event.artist as FlashEventListItem['artist']) ?? null,
110	    location: (event.location as FlashEventListItem['location']) ?? null,
111	    slot_summary: summaryMap.get(event.id) ?? { total: 0, booked: 0, available: 0 },
112	  }))
113	}

119	  eventId: string
120	): Promise<FlashEventDetail | null> {
121	  const supabase = await createClient()
122	
123	  const { data: event, error } = await supabase
124	    .from('flash_events')
125	    .select(`
126	      *,
127	      artist:artists(id, display_name, avatar_url, bio, specialties),
128	      location:locations(id, name, address, city, state)
129	    `)
130	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
131	    .eq('id', eventId)
132	    .maybeSingle()
133	
134	  if (error) {
135	    logger.error({ error, studioId, eventId }, 'getFlashEvent failed')
136	    throw new Error('Failed to load flash event')
137	  }
138	  if (!event) return null
139	
140	  const { data: designs } = await supabase
141	    .from('flash_event_designs')
142	    .select('*')
143	    .eq('flash_event_id', eventId)
144	    .order('display_order', { ascending: true })
145	
146	  const { data: slots } = await supabase
147	    .from('flash_event_slots')
148	    .select('status')
149	    .eq('flash_event_id', eventId)
150	
151	  const slotCounts = (slots ?? []).reduce(
152	    (acc, s) => {
153	      acc.total += 1
154	      if (s.status === 'booked') acc.booked += 1
155	      if (s.status === 'reserved') acc.reserved += 1
156	      if (s.status === 'open') acc.available += 1
157	      return acc
158	    },
159	    { total: 0, booked: 0, reserved: 0, available: 0 }
160	  )
161	
162	  return {
163	    ...event,

165	    location: (event.location as FlashEventDetail['location']) ?? null,
166	    designs: designs ?? [],
167	    slot_summary: slotCounts,
168	  }
169	}

217

263	--    Inserts open slots from event start_time → end_time at slot_duration_min
264	--    intervals on event_date. Skips slots that already exist (idempotent).
265	--    Must be called as studio member (service-role in webhook/action).
266	-- ============================================================
267	
268	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_flash_event_slots(p_event_id uuid)
269	RETURNS int  -- returns number of slots generated
270	LANGUAGE plpgsql
271	SECURITY DEFINER
272	AS $$
273	DECLARE
274	  v_event         flash_events%ROWTYPE;
275	  v_slot_start    timestamptz;
276	  v_slot_end      timestamptz;
277	  v_event_tz      text;
278	  v_base_date     date;
279	  v_current       timestamptz;
280	  v_count         int := 0;
281	BEGIN
282	  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = p_event_id;
283	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
284	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_event not found: %', p_event_id;
285	  END IF;
286	
287	  -- Resolve studio timezone
288	  SELECT timezone INTO v_event_tz FROM studios WHERE id = v_event.studio_id;
289	  v_event_tz := COALESCE(v_event_tz, 'UTC');
290	
291	  v_base_date := v_event.event_date;
292	
293	  -- Build start timestamp in studio local time, then convert to UTC
294	  v_current := (v_base_date::text || ' ' || v_event.start_time::text)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE v_event_tz;
295	
296	  LOOP
297	    v_slot_start := v_current;
298	    v_slot_end   := v_current + (v_event.slot_duration_min || ' minutes')::interval;
299	
300	    -- Stop if slot_end exceeds end_time
301	    EXIT WHEN v_slot_end > (v_base_date::text || ' ' || v_event.end_time::text)::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE v_event_tz;
302	
303	    -- Respect max_slots
304	    EXIT WHEN v_event.max_slots IS NOT NULL AND v_count >= v_event.max_slots;
305	
306	    INSERT INTO flash_event_slots (flash_event_id, slot_start, slot_end, status)
307	    VALUES (p_event_id, v_slot_start, v_slot_end, 'open')
308	    ON CONFLICT (flash_event_id, slot_start) DO NOTHING;
309	
310	    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
311	    v_count := v_count + 1;  -- approximate; ON CONFLICT may not insert
312	
313	    v_current := v_slot_end;
314	  END LOOP;
315	
316	  -- Re-count actual slots
317	  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM flash_event_slots WHERE flash_event_id = p_event_id AND status = 'open';
318	  RETURN v_count;
319	END;
320	$$;

324	--    SECURITY DEFINER — called by anon public booking page.

333	  p_client_info  jsonb  -- { first_name, last_name?, email, phone?, notes? }
334	)

338	AS $$
339	DECLARE
340	  v_studio       studios%ROWTYPE;
341	  v_event        flash_events%ROWTYPE;
342	  v_slot         flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
343	  v_client_id    uuid;
344	  v_booking_id   uuid;
345	  v_booking_token text;
346	  v_artist_id    uuid;
347	BEGIN
348	  -- Resolve studio
349	  SELECT * INTO v_studio FROM studios WHERE slug = p_studio_slug AND status = 'active';
350	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
351	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'studio_not_found');
352	  END IF;
353	
354	  -- Resolve event (must be public+published)
355	  SELECT * INTO v_event
356	  FROM flash_events
357	  WHERE studio_id = v_studio.id
358	    AND slug = p_event_slug
359	    AND public = true
360	    AND status = 'published';
361	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
362	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'event_not_found');
363	  END IF;
364	
365	  -- Lock and claim slot atomically
366	  SELECT * INTO v_slot
367	  FROM flash_event_slots
368	  WHERE id = p_slot_id
369	    AND flash_event_id = v_event.id
370	    AND status = 'open'
371	  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
372	
373	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
374	    -- Either slot gone or already locked by concurrent request
375	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'slot_unavailable');
376	  END IF;
377	
378	  -- Expire stale reservations opportunistically
379	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
380	  SET status = 'open', booking_id = NULL, reserved_until = NULL
381	  WHERE flash_event_id = v_event.id
382	    AND status = 'reserved'
383	    AND reserved_until < now();
384	
385	  -- Upsert client by email within this studio
386	  INSERT INTO clients (studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, source, created_at, updated_at)
387	  VALUES (
388	    v_studio.id,
389	    p_client_info->>'first_name',
390	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'last_name', ''),
391	    LOWER(TRIM(p_client_info->>'email')),
392	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'phone', ''),
393	    'public',
394	    now(),
395	    now()
396	  )
397	  ON CONFLICT (studio_id, email) DO UPDATE
398	    SET updated_at = now()
399	  RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;
400	
401	  -- Resolve artist (use event artist if set, else use a placeholder approach)
402	  v_artist_id := v_event.artist_id;
403	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
404	    -- Pick the first active artist for this studio as a fallback
405	    SELECT id INTO v_artist_id FROM artists
406	    WHERE studio_id = v_studio.id AND status = 'active'
407	    ORDER BY sort_order LIMIT 1;
408	  END IF;
409	
410	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
411	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'no_artist_available');
412	  END IF;
413	
414	  -- Generate booking token
415	  v_booking_token := gen_random_uuid()::text;
416	  v_booking_id    := gen_random_uuid();
417	
418	  -- Create pending booking
419	  INSERT INTO bookings (
420	    id, studio_id, client_id, artist_id,
421	    scheduled_at, duration_min,
422	    status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid,
423	    booking_token, source,
424	    notes, client_notes,
425	    location_id, metadata,
426	    consent_required,
427	    created_at, updated_at
428	  ) VALUES (
429	    v_booking_id,
430	    v_studio.id,
431	    v_client_id,
432	    v_artist_id,
433	    v_slot.slot_start,
434	    v_event.slot_duration_min,
435	    'pending',
436	    v_event.slot_price_cents,
437	    v_event.deposit_cents,
438	    false,
439	    v_booking_token,
440	    'public',
441	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'notes', ''),
442	    NULL,
443	    v_event.location_id,
444	    jsonb_build_object('flash_event_id', v_event.id, 'flash_event_slug', v_event.slug),
445	    false,
446	    now(),
447	    now()
448	  );
449	
450	  -- Reserve the slot (15-minute hold)
451	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
452	  SET status         = 'reserved',
453	      booking_id     = v_booking_id,
454	      reserved_until = now() + interval '15 minutes'
455	  WHERE id = v_slot.id;
456	
457	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
458	    'booking_token', v_booking_token,
459	    'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
460	    'slot_id',       v_slot.id
461	  );
462	END;
463	$$;
464	
465	-- ============================================================
466	-- 8. confirm_flash_slot_booking(booking_id)
467	--    Called by webhook after deposit paid. Transitions slot reserved → booked.
468	-- ============================================================
469	
470	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION confirm_flash_slot_booking(p_booking_id uuid)
471	RETURNS boolean
472	LANGUAGE plpgsql
473	SECURITY DEFINER
474	AS $$
475	BEGIN
476	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
477	  SET status = 'booked', reserved_until = NULL
478	  WHERE booking_id = p_booking_id
479	    AND status IN ('open', 'reserved');
480	
481	  RETURN FOUND;
482	END;
483	$$;

489	--    Policies: studio members can upload; public can read when event is published.

# Flash Events Page — Deep Audit Implementation

## Context

InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). Mission: take the page from "demos as broken" to **"Saturday-morning mission control"** — publish a sheet on Wednesday, fill it by Friday, run the day on Saturday, close the books before dinner.

The audit gives a definitive verdict per element: **5 cuts · 1 move · 5 fixes · 11 adds**. This plan ports every verdict into surgical code changes against the existing implementation, reusing existing primitives wherever possible (PageShell, PageHeader, FlashEventDetailShell, formatCurrency, qrcode pkg, Resend/Twilio queue jobs, `enqueueSendDepositLink`).

Stack A · Next.js 16 · Supabase · feature-key `flash_events` (Studio+) · brand: Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only.

---

## The Long Prompt (master spec — the single source of truth for execution)

This is the contract. Every cut/fix/add lives here. Implementation phases below decompose it.

### A. INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

**A1.** Status filter on `/flash-events` reduces from 6 → 4 chips: `Upcoming · Drafts · Completed · All`. Drop `Published`, drop `Cancelled`. Cancelled events surface inside `All` with a destructive status badge — they don't deserve top-level real estate.

**A2.** Detail page tab strip reduces from 5 → 3: `Overview · Designs · Slots`. Drop `Bookings` (fold into Slots — a booking IS a slot with a client). Drop `Settings` (the Edit button at the top opens the same editor — two paths to one place).

## Phases

### Phase 0 — Schema migrations (Dato)

Create [supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql](supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql):

1. ALTER `flash_event_slots`:
   - Add `no_show_marked_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `grace_expires_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `checked_in_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `walk_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - DROP existing status CHECK, ADD new with `'no_show'` value: `CHECK (status IN ('open','reserved','booked','blocked','no_show'))`
   - ADD CHECK `(status <> 'booked' OR booking_id IS NOT NULL)` — enforces B1 invariant going forward
2. ALTER `flash_events`:
   - Add `completed_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `tips_collected_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
3. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_walkin(p_slot_id uuid, p_client_info jsonb, p_charge_at_desk boolean) returns jsonb` — SECURITY DEFINER, mirrors `public_reserve_flash_slot` but with `source='walk-in'` and slot transitions directly to `booked` (skip reserved).
4. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean`.
5. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean`.
6. New RPC `duplicate_flash_event(p_event_id uuid) returns uuid` — deep-copies designs.
7. New RPC `close_flash_event(p_event_id uuid) returns jsonb` — returns close-out summary, sets status.
8. Update `confirm_flash_slot_booking` RPC to set `grace_expires_at = slot_start + interval '15 minutes'`.
9. New index `idx_flash_event_slots_grace ON flash_event_slots(grace_expires_at) WHERE status='booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL` (for sweep job).
10. Backfill: for any existing `booked` slot with `null booking_id`, set `status='open'` (data hygiene).
11. After migration: `pnpm db:types` → regenerate [lib/supabase/types.ts](lib/supabase/types.ts).

# Flash Events Page — Deep Audit Implementation

## Context

InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). Mission: take the page from "demos as broken" to **"Saturday-morning mission control"** — publish a sheet on Wednesday, fill it by Friday, run the day on Saturday, close the books before dinner.

The audit gives a definitive verdict per element: **5 cuts · 1 move · 5 fixes · 11 adds**. This plan ports every verdict into surgical code changes against the existing implementation, reusing existing primitives wherever possible (PageShell, PageHeader, FlashEventDetailShell, formatCurrency, qrcode pkg, Resend/Twilio queue jobs, `enqueueSendDepositLink`).

Stack A · Next.js 16 · Supabase · feature-key `flash_events` (Studio+) · brand: Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only.

---

## The Long Prompt (master spec — the single source of truth for execution)

This is the contract. Every cut/fix/add lives here. Implementation phases below decompose it.

### A. INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

**A1.** Status filter on `/flash-events` reduces from 6 → 4 chips: `Upcoming · Drafts · Completed · All`. Drop `Published`, drop `Cancelled`. Cancelled events surface inside `All` with a destructive status badge — they don't deserve top-level real estate.

**A2.** Detail page tab strip reduces from 5 → 3: `Overview · Designs · Slots`. Drop `Bookings` (fold into Slots — a booking IS a slot with a client). Drop `Settings` (the Edit button at the top opens the same editor — two paths to one place).

**A3.** Detail page header actions reorder: `[Edit] [Publish if draft] [View public page] [⋯ overflow]`. The destructive `Cancel event` moves into the `⋯` overflow dropdown menu with red text + AlertDialog confirm. No destructive button at primary visual weight.

### B. P0 SHIP BLOCKERS — must fix before anything else

**B1. Slots tab Client column** — Demo data shows "—" for booked rows. Root cause: `flash_event_slots.booking_id` not linked to a `bookings` row in seed, so `slot.booking?.client` is null. The render code at [components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx:91-100](components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx#L91-L100) is correct; the data link is broken. Fix in seed module + add Realtime constraint that any slot with `status='booked'` MUST have non-null `booking_id` (CHECK constraint).

**B2. Slots tab Deposit column** — Same root cause as B1. Once B1 fix lands, [components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx:103-113](components/flash-events/FlashEventSlotsTab.tsx#L103-L113) will render `Paid · $100 / Pending` correctly.

**B3. Edit form artist/location dropdowns** — code at [components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx:132-145](components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx#L132-L145) renders `display_name` correctly; the PDF "shows raw UUID" claim may stem from `defaultValue={event.artist_id ?? '__none__'}` showing the value when artist list hasn't loaded. Add SSR pre-loaded artist list verification + `<SelectValue placeholder>` polish + handle case where `event.artist_id` doesn't match any loaded artist (orphaned reference). Show name not UUID always.

**B4. Cents-based pricing input** — [components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx:218-237](components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx#L218-L237) labels read "Slot Price (cents)" with raw cent values. Replace with a `<MoneyInput>` component that shows dollars (`$250.00`), accepts decimal input, and converts to cents on submit via hidden field. New form action `name="slotPriceCents"` still receives cents.

**B5. Server-action `__none__` sentinel** — [app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts:111-114](app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts#L111-L114) accepts `locationId` / `artistId` strings raw. If form submits `'__none__'`, it gets passed to the schema. Sanitize: `formData.get('artistId') === '__none__' ? null : formData.get('artistId')`.

### C. CUTS

**C1.** Remove `Published` filter chip from [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:14-21](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L14-L21).
**C2.** Remove `Cancelled` filter chip (same file).
**C3.** Remove `bookings` tab from `TABS` in [components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx:48-54](components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx#L48-L54).
**C4.** Remove `settings` tab (same file).
**C5.** Delete file [components/flash-events/FlashEventBookingsTab.tsx](components/flash-events/FlashEventBookingsTab.tsx) entirely (data moves into Slots).
**C6.** Delete `SettingsTab` component inside FlashEventDetailShell.
**C7.** Update `VALID_STATUS_FILTERS` in [app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx:23](app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx#L23) to drop `published` + `cancelled` (add fallback redirect logic so old links don't 404; default to `upcoming`).

### D. MOVES

**D1.** `Cancel event` button → DropdownMenu overflow. New component pattern at top of `FlashEventDetailShell.tsx`:
```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" size="sm" />}>
    <MoreHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setDuplicateOpen(true)}>Duplicate event</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setCloseOpen(true)} disabled={status !== 'published'}>Close event</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setCancelOpen(true)} className="text-destructive">Cancel event</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

### E. FIXES

**E1.** Cover image upload — extend Edit form to support cover image upload to `flash-event-assets` bucket. Empty card thumbnail at [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:103-107](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L103-L107) currently shows fallback Zap icon. After fix, fallback uses `event.artist.avatar_url` if present, else generates a deterministic editorial gradient from `event.id`.

**E2.** Slots-tab `Action` column — replace lock-icon placeholder with explicit row-level dropdown `[⋯]` containing: `SMS reminder · Reschedule · Refund deposit · Mark walk-in · Mark no-show`. Each item disabled based on slot status (e.g., Mark walk-in only on `open`, Refund only when deposit paid).

**E3.** Server-action sentinel sanitization — see B5.

**E4.** Slots tab Draft state — keep current empty state copy, but add "Designs uploaded: N · Add more before publishing" hint linking to Designs tab.

**E5.** Status pill styling — add `cancelled` to STATUS_CONFIG in [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:23-31](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L23-L31) (already present; verify) so Cancelled events render correctly inside `All` filter view.

### F. ADDS

**F1. Stat strip above grid** — 4 KPI cards on `/flash-events` listing page above the filter chips:
- `UPCOMING` count — events with `event_date >= today AND status IN ('draft','published')`
- `SLOTS FILLED · 30D` — `booked_slots / total_slots` for events in the next 30 days
- `REVENUE LOCKED` — sum of `slot_price_cents` across all booked slots in next 30 days
- `DEPOSITS HELD` — sum of `deposit_cents` across booked slots where `deposit_paid = true` and `event_date >= today`

KPI styling: Inter 800, tabular-nums, Onyx number, Stone uppercase label tracking-0.08em. Single Rust 2px left border on `REVENUE LOCKED` (the hero KPI per viewport).

Implementation: new query `getFlashEventsKPIs(studioId)` in [lib/flash-events/queries.ts](lib/flash-events/queries.ts) returning typed `{ upcoming: number; slotsFilled: { booked: number; total: number }; revenueLockedCents: number; depositsHeldCents: number }`. Render in new `<FlashEventsStatStrip>` Server Component.

**F2. Revenue projection on event card** — extend `FlashEventCard` at [components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx:78](components/flash-events/FlashEventsListClient.tsx#L78) to show `$X / $Y` (collected/locked) under the booked count. Compute from new field `revenue_locked_cents` added to `FlashEventListItem`.

**F3. Public URL + QR on Overview tab** — add new `<EventShareCard>` to `OverviewTab` showing:
- Public URL displayed as monospace text + `[Copy link]` button (copies to clipboard, toast "Link copied")
- Downloadable QR code (generated client-side via `qrcode` pkg already in package.json) with `[Download PNG]` button at 1024px
- Only visible when `status === 'published' AND public === true`
- Component path: `components/flash-events/EventShareCard.tsx` (new)

**F4. Revenue panel on Overview tab** — new card below existing Event Details:
```
REVENUE
  Locked         $3,000   (booked × slot_price)
  Collected      $1,100   (booked × deposit where deposit_paid)
  Outstanding    $1,900   (locked − collected)
  Tips           $0       (post-event entry)
```
Server-side compute from slot+booking joins. Hidden until first slot booked. Pro+ gated visually but data always loaded.

**F5. Design column on Slots tab** — extend `FlashEventSlotWithBooking` query to also select `design:flash_event_designs(title, size_description, price_cents)` via the slot's `design_id` FK. Render in Client column as second line: `▸ Design B (3in × 4in · $275)`. If client picked design via public booking, link is set there; if via walk-in entry, set on conversion.

Schema: `flash_event_slots.design_id` already exists (nullable FK to `flash_event_designs`). Add query join. Add migration to backfill demo data.

**F6. Walk-in conversion button** — on Open rows in Slots tab, action menu item `Mark walk-in` opens a slide-in `<WalkInForm>` Drawer with:
- Client first name + last name + email + phone
- Optional design picker (dropdown of available designs)
- `[Charge at desk]` toggle (default ON — skips deposit collection, marks slot as `booked` with `deposit_paid=false` + `booking.source='walk-in'`)
- `[Send Stripe link]` toggle (calls `enqueueSendDepositLink` to email/SMS the client a Dodo Payments checkout URL)

New server action `markSlotWalkInAction(eventId, slotId, formData)` — uses service-role client to: upsert client → create `bookings` row → set `slot.booking_id` + `slot.status='booked'` atomically via new RPC `mark_flash_slot_walkin(p_slot_id, p_client_info, p_charge_at_desk)`.

**F7. No-show fee + grace timer** — three pieces:
- New column `flash_event_slots.no_show_marked_at timestamptz` (nullable)
- New column `flash_event_slots.grace_expires_at timestamptz` (set to `slot_start + interval '15 minutes'` on booking confirmation; computed in `confirm_flash_slot_booking` RPC update)
- Background job `flash-no-show-sweep` (BullMQ, runs every 5 min): finds slots where `now() > grace_expires_at AND status='booked' AND booking.checked_in_at IS NULL`, marks `status='no_show'` (new enum value), converts `deposit_cents` to `no_show_fee_cents` line on the booking
- Slots tab new status pill `No-show` (Stone+strike-through styling, since `cancelled` palette is reserved for events not slots)
- Action menu item `Mark no-show` immediately on any booked row (manual override)
- Action menu item `Mark checked-in` on booked rows clears the timer
- Schema migration: add `no_show` to `flash_event_slots.status` CHECK constraint enum

**F8. SMS reminders (T-24h + T-2h)** — on slot transition to `booked` (in `confirm_flash_slot_booking` RPC + walk-in RPC), enqueue two BullMQ jobs:
- `send-sms` at `slot_start - 24h`: "Hey {name}, your flash slot at {studio} is tomorrow at {time}. Reply CANCEL to free your slot."
- `send-sms` at `slot_start - 2h`: "Today's the day — see you at {time}. Studio address: {addr}. Reply 1 if running late."

Use existing queue infrastructure in [lib/queue.ts](lib/queue.ts). Gated on `sms_reminders` feature key (Studio+). Cancel jobs on slot cancel/no-show via `removeRepeatable`.

**F9. Duplicate event** — overflow menu item that posts to new `duplicateFlashEventAction(eventId)`. Creates a draft copy with: same designs (deep-copied), same slot_duration_min/start/end/max_slots/pricing, same artist/location, BUT `event_date = NULL` (forces user to pick), `status='draft'`, new slug (auto: `{original-slug}-copy-{n}`). Redirects to `/flash-events/{newId}/edit` with date field auto-focused.

**F10. Close-out report** — new `Close event` overflow menu item (enabled when `status='published' AND event_date <= today`). Opens AlertDialog summary:
```
{Event title} closed.
- {n} bookings completed · {m} no-shows
- $X slot revenue · $Y deposits collected · $Z tips
- Top design: {design title} ({k} bookings)
- Artist payout: ${calculated}
[Email me a copy]   [Done]
```
Action: `closeFlashEventAction(eventId)` sets `status='completed'`, `completed_at=now()`, enqueues optional summary email to `auth.email`.

**F11. SMS reminder dispatch UI** — Slots tab row action `Send link` — only visible on `reserved` rows where deposit hasn't been paid. Calls `enqueueSendDepositLink` with the client's preferred channel. Toast: "Reminder queued — sending in <60s."

**F12. Cover image upload + QR/PDF flyer download** — extend Designs tab + Edit form upload widget to support cover image. Surface a `[Download flyer PDF]` button on Overview that generates a printable A4 PDF: cover image header + 12-slot grid showing time + design thumbnail + QR code per slot. Use existing PDF generation worker pattern (see `generate-consent-pdf` in queue).

### G. EMPTY STATES

**G1.** Listing zero events → `Create your first flash event` (Instrument Serif H2) + body + `[+ New event]` Onyx + `[From template]` outline. Template option seeds default 12-slot 1hr config.

**G2.** Filter returned zero → `No events match this view` + `[Clear filters]` + `[Edit view]`.

**G3.** Slots tab Draft → existing copy, link to Designs tab, hint "Designs uploaded: {n}".

### H. BRAND COMPLIANCE

- Bone `#F7F7F5` page bg always. Bookings/slots tables on Bone, hairline Stone borders (`shadow-soft` for cards).
- Onyx CTAs (`+ New event`, `Save`, `Publish`, `Mark walk-in`, `Send link`, `Close event`).
- Rust ONLY for: active filter chip · LIVE pulse on running events · 2px left border on `REVENUE LOCKED` KPI · `Cancel event` (in overflow) text. Max 1–2 Rust accents per viewport.
- Stone for all secondary text, labels (`UPCOMING`, `REVENUE LOCKED` uppercase tracking-0.08em).
- Instrument Serif: page title `Flash Events` (already in PageHeader), empty-state H2 (`Create your first flash event`), close-out summary title `{Event title} closed.`. Never on body, labels, or numbers.
- KPI numbers: Inter 800, tabular-nums.
- Tabular figures on every number.
- No emoji. No exclamation marks.
- All shadows from `shadow-soft / shadow-card / shadow-soft-md / shadow-lift` — never `shadow-md / shadow-lg`.
- All colors via tokens — no raw hex except in [app/globals.css](app/globals.css).
- `<FeatureGate feature="flash_events">` wrapper on `/flash-events` route. Server: `requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, 'flash_events')` in page.tsx.

---

## Phases

### Phase 0 — Schema migrations (Dato)

Create [supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql](supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql):

1. ALTER `flash_event_slots`:
   - Add `no_show_marked_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `grace_expires_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `checked_in_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `walk_in boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - DROP existing status CHECK, ADD new with `'no_show'` value: `CHECK (status IN ('open','reserved','booked','blocked','no_show'))`
   - ADD CHECK `(status <> 'booked' OR booking_id IS NOT NULL)` — enforces B1 invariant going forward
2. ALTER `flash_events`:
   - Add `completed_at timestamptz NULL`
   - Add `tips_collected_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
3. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_walkin(p_slot_id uuid, p_client_info jsonb, p_charge_at_desk boolean) returns jsonb` — SECURITY DEFINER, mirrors `public_reserve_flash_slot` but with `source='walk-in'` and slot transitions directly to `booked` (skip reserved).
4. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean`.
5. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean`.

8. Update `confirm_flash_slot_booking` RPC to set `grace_expires_at = slot_start + interval '15 minutes'`.
9. New index `idx_flash_event_slots_grace ON flash_event_slots(grace_expires_at) WHERE status='booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL` (for sweep job).
10. Backfill: for any existing `booked` slot with `null booking_id`, set `status='open'` (data hygiene).
11. After migration: `pnpm db:types` → regenerate [lib/supabase/types.ts](lib/supabase/types.ts).

## Context

InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). The audit gives a definitive verdict per element: **5 cuts · 1 move · 5 fixes · 11 adds**. # Flash Events Page — Deep Audit Implementation

## Context

InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). Mission: take the page from "demos as broken" to **"Saturday-morning mission control"** — publish a sheet on Wednesday, fill it by Friday, run the day on Saturday, close the books before dinner.

The audit gives a definitive verdict per element: **5 cuts · 1 move · 5 fixes · 11 adds**. This plan ports every verdict into surgical code changes against the existing implementation, reusing existing primitives wherever possible (PageShell, PageHeader, FlashEventDetailShell, formatCurrency, qrcode pkg, Resend/Twilio queue jobs, `enqueueSendDepositLink`).

Stack A · Next.js 16 · Supabase · feature-key `flash_events` (Studio+) · brand: Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust only.

2. ALTER `flash_events`:
   - ADD COLUMN `completed_at timestamptz NULL`

5. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates slot is currently 'booked'. Sets checked_in_at=now(). Returns true.

Logic: validate slot exists + status='open', upsert client by email scoped to studio (mirror upsert from existing `public_reserve_flash_slot`), create bookings row with source='walk-in', set walk_in=true on slot, transition slot directly to 'booked' (skip reserved), atomic via FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. 4. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates slot is currently 'booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL. Sets status='no_show', no_show_marked_at=now(). Updates linked booking row: status='no_show'. Returns true if transition occurred.

5. New RPC `mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid) returns boolean` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates slot is currently 'booked'. Sets checked_in_at=now(). Returns true.

6. New RPC `duplicate_flash_event(p_event_id uuid) returns uuid` — SECURITY DEFINER. Inserts a new flash_events row copying all columns EXCEPT: id (new uuid), slug (append `-copy-` + extract(epoch from now())::int), status='draft', published_at=NULL, cancelled_at=NULL, completed_at=NULL, event_date=CURRENT_DATE + 14. Deep-copy all flash_event_designs rows with FK pointing to new event id. Do NOT copy slots. Return new event id.

7. New RPC `close_flash_event(p_event_id uuid) returns jsonb` — SECURITY DEFINER. Validates event status='published'. Sets status='completed', completed_at=now(). Returns summary jsonb: `{ event_id, completed_count, no_show_count, slot_revenue_cents, deposits_collected_cents, tips_cents, top_design: { id, title, count } | null, artist_id }`.

8. UPDATE existing `confirm_flash_slot_booking(p_booking_id uuid)` RPC to ALSO set `grace_expires_at = slot_start + interval '15 minutes'` when transitioning to booked. Use CREATE OR REPLACE.

9. ADD INDEX `idx_flash_event_slots_grace ON flash_event_slots(grace_expires_at) WHERE status='booked' AND checked_in_at IS NULL`.

10. Backfill (BEFORE adding chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking): `UPDATE flash_event_slots SET status='open' WHERE status='booked' AND booking_id IS NULL;`

11. Inline studio-membership check inside SECURITY DEFINER staff-facing RPCs (no_show, checked_in, duplicate, close) — RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' if auth.uid() not a studio member. `mark_flash_slot_walkin` skips this (called from server action with service-role client which has no auth.uid).

12. Full ROLLBACK comments at the top.

- Idempotent: use `DO $$ BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column THEN NULL; END $$;` for ADD COLUMN.
- For CHECK constraint replacement: try `ALTER TABLE flash_event_slots DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS flash_event_slots_status_check;` then re-add named.
- Comment heavily.
- After writing, attempt `pnpm db:migrate` if local Supabase is running, else skip and note. Then `pnpm db:types`.

Phase 2 = P0 ship-blocker fixes for Flash Events page. 5 fixes total: ### B5 — Server-action sentinel sanitization File: app/(app)/flash-events/actions.ts Both `createFlashEventAction` (lines 30-72) and `updateFlashEventAction` (lines 76-133) accept `artistId` / `locationId` from FormData and pass them raw. Convert `'__none__'` → `null` BEFORE schema parse: In createFlashEventAction (lines 39-56), replace the artist/location lines: ```ts const artistIdRaw = formData.get('artistId') const locationIdRaw = formData.get('locationId') const artistId = (typeof artistIdRaw === 'string' && artistIdRaw !== '__none__' && artistIdRaw !== '') ? artistIdRaw : undefined const locationId = (typeof locationIdRaw === 'string' && locationIdRaw !== '__none__' && locationIdRaw !== '') ? locationIdRaw : undefined ``` Then use `artistId` and `locationId` in the `raw` object. In updateFlashEventAction (lines 111-114), similarly: when `locationId === '__none__'` or empty → `raw.locationId = null`. When `artistId === '__none__'` or empty → `raw.artistId = null`. ### B4 — Dollar input (replace cents inputs) File 1: components/ui/money-input.tsx (NEW). A small client component: ```tsx 'use client' import { useState } from 'react' import { Input } from './input' interface Props { name: string defaultCents?: number required?: boolean disabled?: boolean id?: string placeholder?: string } export function MoneyInput({ name, defaultCents = 0, required, disabled, id, placeholder }: Props) { const [dollars, setDollars] = useState((defaultCents / 100).toFixed(2)) const cents = Math.round(parseFloat(dollars || '0') * 100) || 0 return (
$ setDollars(e.target.value)} required={required} disabled={disabled} id={id} placeholder={placeholder ?? '0.00'} className="pl-7 tabular-nums" />
) } ``` File 2: components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx (lines 218-251) — replace the 3 cents Input blocks for `slotPriceCents`, `depositCents`. Keep `maxSlots` as plain Input (it's not money). Update labels: "Slot price" / "Deposit" (drop the "(cents)" suffix). Use ``. File 3: there is also a `new/page.tsx` and likely a `NewFlashEventForm.tsx` sibling. Find it via `find components/flash-events -name "NewFlashEventForm*"` or grep. If found, apply same MoneyInput swap. If `new/page.tsx` inlines the form, edit there. ### B3 — Dropdown orphaned-FK guard File: components/flash-events/EditFlashEventForm.tsx — line 132 `defaultValue={event.artist_id ?? '__none__'}`. If event.artist_id is set but the artist no longer exists in the loaded `artists` array (deleted artist), the Select will fall back to showing the raw ID. Add a guard: ```tsx const artistDefaultValue = event.artist_id && artists.some(a => a.id === event.artist_id) ? event.artist_id : '__none__' ``` Use that for `defaultValue`. Same pattern for location at line 195. ### B1 + B2 — Demo seed: link booked slots to real bookings File: scripts/seed/demo/modules/flash.ts Read the file first. The current seed creates 12 slots, some marked `booked` BUT does not insert corresponding `bookings` rows OR set `flash_event_slots.booking_id`. Fix: - For each slot you mark `booked` (~4-5 of them), first INSERT a `bookings` row using one of the demo clients in the studio (find demo clients via `clients` table where studio_id = demo studio ID `'11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111'`). The booking must have: - `studio_id` = demo studio - `client_id` = a real demo client UUID - `artist_id` = the event's artist (if null, fall back to first active artist) - `scheduled_at` = the slot's `slot_start` - `duration_min` = event's `slot_duration_min` - `status` = 'confirmed' - `price_cents` = event's `slot_price_cents` - `deposit_cents` = event's `deposit_cents` - `deposit_paid` = true - `booking_token` = a fresh uuid - `source` = 'public' - `metadata` = `{ flash_event_id, flash_event_slug }` - Capture the new booking's id, then UPDATE `flash_event_slots` SET `booking_id` = that id, `status` = 'booked'. - For at least one slot, also set `design_id` to one of the inserted designs (so the new design column has data to render). - Keep idempotency — the seed must work on `pnpm db:seed:demo` (no-op if already run) AND `pnpm db:seed:demo:reset` (full wipe + reseed). ### D1 — Move Cancel event to overflow DropdownMenu File: components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx — header actions block (lines 122-173). Replace the inline `Cancel event` AlertDialog (lines 145-172) with a `DropdownMenu` that opens an overflow `[⋯]`. Use `onSelect={() => toast.info('Duplicate coming in next pass')}` for now; phase 3g will replace. - `Close event` — disabled for now (placeholder; phase 3g wires). - (separator) - `Cancel event` — opens AlertDialog (use the existing dialog markup), red text class. } from 'lucide-react'

/**
 * NavRole includes preset roles and custom roles.

 * For nav item filtering, resolve custom roles to their cloned_from parent via
 * `resolveNavRole()` in lib/team/permissions.ts before comparing to requiredRoles.

export type NavRole = PresetNavRole | `custom:${string}`
